shortDescription: Australia's IDP Education ASX:IEL said on Tuesday it had rejected a takeover proposal from Blackstone that valued the firm at about A$694.7 million ($493.79 million), saying the approach substantially undervalued IDP.($1 = 1.4069 Australian dollars)
